Your holdings: MUU (-16.32%), SOXL (-42.87%), and SPAL (-21.35%) are all leveraged ETFs in "SELL" status, showing significant losses. Margin amplifies these drawdowns, making them extra painful.

Watch: Keep a close eye on broader chip sector news and the performance of your leveraged ETFs. Also, monitor any shifts in major fund manager sentiment.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, losing chip positions in a weakening sector.
plays: Trim SOXL, down -42.87%, as the chip rout spreads. Respect the stop at 200 to limit further losses.
Trim MUU, down -16.32%, given the chip sector weakness. Consider adjusting its stop from 31.6.
Consider a new buy on SOXS (inverse chip ETF) at 37.1-37.04 with a stop at 36.91, given the spreading chip rout.
